versions.changelog:
Initial release for agentsmd-creator:

- Generates AGENTS.md for project repositories to serve as an AI-facing project README.
- Implements a 6-chapter template structure, covering project overview, quick start, architecture, coding style, local development, and documentation navigation.
- Scans repository to tailor content based on project maturity (new/existing), primary tech stack, and existing documentation.
- Analyzes project files to extract and/or generate coding standards and architecture docs; merges with existing files where applicable.
- Outputs/update AGENTS.md, docs/CODING_STYLE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, and creates a CLAUDE.md symlink for compatibility.
- Ensures concise, actionable documentation (≤ 200 lines), with detailed sections linked externally.
